stories.title: Aide aux victimes de Crans-Montana: les 20 millions qui divisent encore à Berne

en.title: Aid to Crans-Montana victims: the 20 million francs still dividing Bern
en.summary: Swiss victims of a New Year's fire in Crans-Montana have received promised payments of 50,000 francs each. Parliament's lower chamber must vote Thursday on an additional 20 million francs for a roundtable initiative, which the Swiss People's Party opposes.

stories.title: Immobilienkonzerne enteignen? Berlin streitet über Lösungen für die Wohnungsnot

en.title: Expropriate real estate corporations? Berlin disputes solutions for housing shortage
en.summary: Five years after Berliners voted to socialize 240,000 apartments, virtually no action has been taken. The debate has resurged during the election campaign and could create serious problems for Germany.

en.summary: Switzerland's F-35 fighter jet acquisition includes an offset arrangement that benefits the Federal Institute of Technology Zurich with an IBM quantum computer.

en.title: The Fed raises rates despite Donald Trump's pressure, another increase expected by end of 2026
en.summary: The US Federal Reserve unanimously increased interest rates by a quarter point to combat inflation at 3.7%, opposing Trump's preferences. Another rate increase is anticipated before the end of 2026.

en.title: Three dead in light aircraft crash against cliff at Loèche-les-Bains
en.summary: A Cirrus SR22T aircraft crashed into a cliff in the Fluhalp region on Tuesday afternoon, killing all three occupants. The plane had departed from Lugano airport and stopped in Sion before the accident.

en.title: Three people die in single-engine plane crash in Loèche-les-Bains
